intro: Orendil Broadleaf is a skilled night elf herbalist and healer stationed at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. Known for his deep knowledge of forest flora, he concocts vital remedies to save young lives across the troubled woodlands.

p: Positioned at Maestra's Post along the western threshold of Ashenvale, Orendil Broadleaf tends to the sick as a skilled healer. Recognized for his masterful knowledge of local herbs and restorative craft, Orendil relies on passing travelers to gather rare natural reagents. Even as tension and conflict encroach upon the forest, his tireless focus remains on safeguarding his kin and soothing their ailments.
